And you are going to head to your left going down this pathway.  You will come into a corner there will be a mirror on your right.  Continue heading down this hallway.  There will be an archway in front of you.  You are going to go thru this archway and then make a right.  You will see a large room with a pool table. You will talk thru this room with the navy curtains on your right.  You are going to head towards the fireplace.
